subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should OpenClaw accept PR 102189's policy of strict effective room_event delivery plus session-stable prompt delivery, stable ambient owner-only tool schemas, and split OpenAI Responses prompt suffixes for cache reuse?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the remaining blocker is not a mechanical fix: it changes cache-visible authorization/tool-prompt policy for ambient room_event turns and spans channel, agent, Codex, and provider boundaries.

options.title: Accept the current PR policy
options.body: Review and land PR 102189 if its tests/proof stay clean, keeping strict visible delivery while stabilizing prompt and tool prefixes.

options.title: Narrow the fix to room-event delivery prompts
options.body: Ask the author to drop or split the owner-only tool inventory and Responses boundary work into separate maintainer-reviewed items.

options.title: Document the current behavior only
options.body: Close the behavior-change path and keep docs as the contract, accepting the reported cache churn as outside this issue's scope.

recommendation.title: Accept the current PR policy
recommendation.body: Review and land PR 102189 if its tests/proof stay clean, keeping strict visible delivery while stabilizing prompt and tool prefixes.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history shows repeated ownership of room-event, group visible-reply, agent tool, and Codex/app-server policy surfaces.
